name: Platform Runtime Demo
tagline: Probe, precheck and use the Anna platform's shared Node.js & Chrome — ship a 5 MiB Executa instead of 316 MiB.
description:
The official companion app for the platform shared-runtime contract (forum #490).

**What it demonstrates**

- **Probe** — which runtimes your Agent provides (`ANNA_CHROME_EXECUTABLE`, `ANNA_NODE_EXECUTABLE`, …), how they were discovered (contract vs legacy-scan vs none), and upgrade advice.
- **Precheck** — preview exactly what an install-time `runtime.requires` check would report on this Agent, including the structured `missing_runtimes` map.
- **Render** — HTML → PNG / PDF through the PLATFORM Chrome via `puppeteer-core` + `executablePath`, with zero browser bytes in the package.
- **Ship it light** — the bundled Executa's binary profile is ≈5 MiB (incl. puppeteer-core) instead of the 316 MiB a bundled-everything build would weigh.

Also useful as a support / triage tool: on not-yet-upgraded Agents it degrades gracefully and explains what is missing.
_comment_logo: "" = clear any stale server value on push (absent key = leave unchanged). Replace with a real hosted URL or a logo_file once the demo has an icon.
_comment_bundled_executas: Executas that ship inside this app. `anna-app apps publish` publishes each one first, then substitutes its server-minted tool_id into every `bundled:<handle>` reference in manifest.json (in memory) and writes bundle/anna-tool-ids.js so the UI bundle can read the same ids.
